local progress = state.time / state.duration
	-- [AnimePlayer: smooth progress] the bar glides to the new position instead of ticking forward; a seek (jump of more than 4 %) lands at once
	do
		local now = mp.get_time()
		local dt = math.min(0.1, math.max(0, now - (self.ap_last_time or now)))
		self.ap_last_time = now
		local shown = self.ap_shown or progress
		if math.abs(progress - shown) > 0.04 then shown = progress else shown = shown + (progress - shown) * math.min(1, dt * 10) end
		self.ap_shown = shown
		if math.abs(progress - shown) > 0.0002 and not state.pause then request_render() end
		progress = shown
	end
	local is_line = options.timeline_style == 'line'
